sections.name: architecture
sections.value: Doctrine: .agents-skills-port/pij-team/TENETS.md (1-6). Stack: Rust crates (crates/core vocabulary · crates/harnesses interaction gate · crates/daemon http+delivery composition root; arch-allowlist via `harness checks`) + the pi extension (.pi/extensions/pij: core/ pi-free, adapters/ runtime seams). FROZEN SEAMS: (a) grace = PIJ_TYPING_GRACE_MS, default 60000, defined ONCE in crates/core/src/delivery.rs (`pub const DEFAULT_TYPING_GRACE_MS`) and exposed additively on the register response as `typing_grace_ms` (u2); the extension reads it from the response (u1) — never a second literal. (b) Hold wire (u2 serves, u1 calls): `POST /v1/hold {seat, msg_id, reason:'human-typing', since_ms}` → spine `delivery.held`; `POST /v1/release {seat, msg_id, at_ms}` → spine `delivery.released`; both additive routes, bearer-authed like /v1/register. Canonical payloads in assets/contracts/hold-events.json. (c) Claude-side rule (u3): `HumanTyping` iff last keystroke evidence < grace; `ComposerBusy` (draft present, no recent keys) no longer defers on its own — it is reported as `draft_sha` context only. (d) Extension semantics (u1): consumePushed claims the row; if a hold applies, the row is NOT acked; inject+ack happen together on release; commands (`compact|new|reload`) and `urgent:true` payloads skip the hold. Sensors: omp/pi → `editor.onChange` (in-process, cannot confuse agent output for typing); Claude/send-keys → existing pane-signals/tmux interaction evidence in crates/harnesses. Snap-in recipe rule: u1 ships the wiring for RustRuntimeSession as a doc-comment recipe; u2 ships the router lines; PM composes.

value.rationale: Three units, three fences, no shared file: u1 TS extension, u2 Rust core+daemon http, u3 Rust harnesses. Wave 0 contract is PM-owned. The only cross-unit literal (grace) is defined in u2 and READ by u1 via the wire, per seam (a).

value.name: contract: hold events + grace
value.responsibility: Canonical JSON for delivery.held / delivery.released payloads, the /v1/hold and /v1/release request bodies, and a register-response sample carrying typing_grace_ms.
value.test_strategy: Consumed by u1/u2/u3 tests; none of its own.
value.note: Written by the PM before any spawn.

value.name: extension typing sensor + hold queue
value.responsibility: Know when the human last typed; hold pushed rows while inside the grace; make holds visible; release in order.
value.interface: core/hold-queue.ts: `class HoldQueue { constructor(clock: () => number, graceMs: number); noteEdit(at: number); shouldHold(at: number): boolean; push(row: HeldRow): void; drain(at: number): HeldRow[]; size(): number }` — pure, clock-injected. pi-runtime.ts: `onEditorChange(cb: (at:number)=>void)` wired from pi's `editor.onChange`. rust-runtime.ts consumePushed: claim → (command or urgent ? inject+ack : hold if shouldHold else inject+ack); a 1 s ticker drains; on hold → client.hold(...) + setStatus(`⏸ ${n} held · typing`); on release → client.release(...) + inject + ack. grace comes from `accepted.typing_grace_ms ?? 60000`.
value.test_strategy: hold-queue.test.ts with a fake clock: hold at 59 s, drain at 60 s, order preserved, commands bypass. rust-runtime.test.ts: claimed-but-held row is NOT acked (fake client records acks), and re-register redelivers. RED first. `bun test .pi/extensions/pij`.
value.note: Do not touch core/session.ts or delivery vocabulary. Timers must be cleared on session_shutdown and re-armed on session_start.

value.name: daemon hold/release rows + grace + honest receipt
value.paths: crates/core/src/delivery.rs (additive: DEFAULT_TYPING_GRACE_MS, HeldEvent/ReleasedEvent types), crates/core/src/wire.rs (additive typing_grace_ms on the register response), crates/daemon/src/http/mod.rs (two new routes + register response field), crates/daemon/src/http/tests.rs, crates/daemon/src/delivery/mod.rs ONLY the extension-stream receipt line (~250-270: queued not delivered until ack), crates/cli/src/main.rs (`state` render of held rows)
value.responsibility: Persist and render holds; expose the single grace value; stop reporting extension-stream pushes as delivered before the extension acks.
value.interface: Routes per u0 contract; spine kinds `delivery.held` {msg_id, seat, reason, since_ms} and `delivery.released` {msg_id, seat, at_ms}; register response gains `typing_grace_ms: u64`; `pij-rs state <seat>` shows `held: N (human-typing since …)`; push receipt for Omp|Pi is `queued{reason: extension-stream}` and the outcome row flips to delivered on inbox-ack.
value.test_strategy: http tests byte-compare spine payloads to the contract file; a receipt test asserts queued-before-ack / delivered-after-ack; `cargo test -p pij-core -p pij-daemon -p pij-cli`. RED first.
value.note: Plan 137 owns the `matches!(harness, Omp|Pi)` arm — do not restructure it; touch only the receipt outcome.

value.name: interaction gate: keystroke recency
value.responsibility: Make `human-typing` mean 'keystroke within grace' for send-keys seats; stop deferring on a parked draft.
value.interface: `InteractionGate::new(tmux, grace_ms)`; verdict: `defer(HumanTyping)` iff last interaction evidence age < grace; `composer_idle=false` with no recent keys → permit, carrying draft_sha; `next_retry_at = last_key + grace`.
value.test_strategy: Fake tmux/pane-signals: (1) key 5 s ago → HumanTyping, retry ≤ grace; (2) draft present, last key 61 s ago → permit + draft_sha; (3) RED control: the old test that expected ComposerBusy to defer forever must FAIL on the new tree and be rewritten with the reason stated. `cargo test -p pij-harnesses`.
value.note: Keep the wire word `human-typing`; only its derivation changes. Do not edit delivery.rs (u2's).

Each coder branches off 136-typing-grace-gate into ../fs3-typing-grace-gate-<unit>; PM merges u2 first (vocabulary + routes), then u3, then u1 (reads the wire). Toolchain pinned; the live daemon is restarted only by the PM at compose.

value.steps: 1) Merge u2; cargo gates. 2) Merge u3; cargo gates. 3) Merge u1; bun test + harness checks. 4) Commit; rebuild + restart the rs daemon WITH PIJ_TELEGRAM_ENV (justfile bounce-rs); verify pid + ping. 5) Live proofs AC1–AC6 with controls recorded FIRST on main for AC2 and AC6. 6) assets/live-proof.md.
value.integration_proof: Composed daemon + extension: an omp seat with a keystroke 5 s ago holds a pushed message (status ⏸ 1 held; spine delivery.held), releases it ≤ 60 s after the last keystroke (delivery.released then inbox-ack); a `compact` command bypasses; killing the seat while held redelivers after re-register; a Claude seat with a parked 61 s-old draft receives, and one with a 5 s-old keystroke queues human-typing with next_retry_at ≤ grace.

value.inputs: plan.dd.md + this guide + branch diff; priority: held==unacked invariant (nothing lost), the single grace definition actually READ by the extension (not a second literal), receipt honesty (queued until ack), the u3 RED control, and that plan 137's match arm was not restructured

value.text: editor.onChange may fire on programmatic edits (inject, paste-by-agent) → false 'typing'. Retire: u1 ignores changes within 200 ms of its own inject/setEditorText and tests it.

A hold with no ack + daemon retry could double-deliver on release. Retire: u2 stops the retry scheduler for rows in held state (delivery.held row present, not released); u1 acks on inject; test the interleaving.

Making extension-stream receipts honest (queued until ack) may break a consumer that expected delivered (honesty-removes-a-load-bearing-fallback). Retire: PM greps consumers of origin=extension-stream/delivered before merging u2 and lists them in live-proof.
Two grace literals drifting (TS 60000 vs Rust). Retire: AC7 — the TS default only applies when the daemon omits the field, and a test asserts the wire value wins.
